steps.title: Fan out
steps.rule: Leave the spawn and spread into the melee ring around Kefka, keeping your own angle so nobody stacks.

OffTank.rule: Go to 7m south of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark C, 9m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's ScheduleInitialFanOut: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: LeftOrder).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark C, 9m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark C, 8m south of the centre.

steps.title: Exaflare wave
steps.rule: For each wave, keep your place across the fire's line and slide along it into a safe lane before the wave hits. Melee and tanks stay close to the boss.
